# Teamboard 3.3

Released 2 September 2026.

## New

- **Card templates.** Save a card's checklist and labels as a template, then
  start new cards from it.
- **Due date reminders.** Teamboard sends an email the day before a card is
  due. Turn reminders off in **Settings > Notifications**.

## Improved

- Boards with more than 500 cards open faster.

## Fixed

- Moving a card between lists no longer resets its checklist.
